title: Faster, steadier road checks behind the scenes
items: The automated check that reads how well the streets stand out from the ground now pauses the town's own animation while it takes each picture. A picture used to wait out several slow frames on the test machine and could give up after ninety seconds, which held back three Prairie Avenue houses that do not touch a road. Nothing changes for a visitor. The checks read the same frames against the same bars, without the wait.
